source: ESAT Content Specification (May 2024) + manual benchmark esat_228_manual_review_v1

math1.permitted_summary: Units, number, ratio, algebra, geometry, statistics, probability at GCSE/A-level core without Further Maths.
math1.inequalities: Linear inequalities only. Rational, quadratic and modulus inequalities are not specified.
math1.polynomials: Standard factorisation and expansion. Polynomial division by quadratics beyond stated scope is not specified.
math1.geometry: Listed circle theorems only. Tangent-secant and power-of-a-point are not specified.
forbidden_without_supply: Mathematics 2 calculus, radians-heavy methods, or change-of-base logarithms

permitted_identities: tan x = sin x / cos x
forbidden_unless_supplied_in_question: angle subtraction or addition beyond supplied relationships
cotangent and reciprocal-trig identities beyond sin/cos/tan
change of base for logarithms — official spec excludes change-of-base questions

permitted: derivative of x^n for integer n (power rule on polynomials)
derivatives of expressions reducible to sums of constant multiples of powers of x after algebraic simplification
forbidden_unless_supplied: product rule
quotient rule
chain rule on non-polynomial compositions (e.g. e^x, ln x, sin x, (x-a)^(-1) after shift)
differentiation of e^x, ln x, sin x, cos x, tan x as the main move
implicit differentiation

permitted: integrate k x^n for integer n (including n = -1 only when already in standard power form after simplification)
definite integrals of polynomials and simple sums/differences of power terms
area under a curve when antiderivative is a polynomial power rule result
forbidden_unless_supplied: integration by parts
integrate ln x or require ln antiderivative
integration by substitution for non-trivial substitutions (e.g. shift to integrate (x+a)^(-2))
antiderivatives arctan(x), ln x, e^x
treating mass as integral of linear density without supplying the formula
limits, removable discontinuities, or limit language as the core method
electric volume charge density Q = rho_q V
formulas not stated in P1

p3_mechanics.upthrust: Qualitative understanding only. Quantitative Archimedes principle U = rho V g or buoyancy proportional to displaced weight is NOT specified.
forbidden_unless_supplied: F = mu R coefficient of friction law
principle of moments
quantitative upthrust / Archimedes calculations
wave interference, path difference, phase change calculations
inverse-distance amplitude laws for sound

cannot_assume: radioactive half-life from P7 unless question is Physics radioactivity topic

forbidden_cross_module: Biology enzyme inhibition mechanisms not in Chemistry spec

forbidden_unless_supplied: branching effects on London forces and saturated vapour pressure beyond stated intermolecular content
haloalkane substitution with ammonia to amines / quaternary ammonium
oxidation of secondary alcohol to ketone with acidified dichromate
germline vs somatic mutation, mosaicism, incomplete penetrance
promoter methylation and epigenetic regulation
coding-strand to mRNA conversion steps and amino-acid chemical property reasoning unless supplied
Chemistry-specific or advanced Biology beyond stated topic codes

decision_procedure: 1. Solve independently. List every fact, formula, identity, theorem and method required.
2. For each item, locate explicit permission in assigned module rules, Mathematics 1 (if allowed), or text supplied in the question.
3. If any required item is forbidden unless supplied and not supplied → out_of_syllabus.
4. If permission is genuinely unclear → borderline (use sparingly).
5. Only if every required item is permitted → in_syllabus.
6. Do not mark in_syllabus merely because the topic title appears in the curriculum snapshot.
